'''Rivaz''' was a [[Professor/Legends|professor]] working at the [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] on [[Raithal/Legends|Raithal]], during the height of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. A subscriber to "[[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]," Rivaz commented on the [[GY-I information analysis droid]] and how it was so useful in analyzing physical phenomena that the science department at the Academy had been using them for [[Standard year/Legends|years]].
